Bhaiya's Teachings — Knowledge Base (Session 57, English)
Why Reiki and Pranic Healers Eventually Burn Out: Borr owed Energy , Dimension, and What "Angel Healing" Really Is

Structural note: this session is a live Q&A/teaching session with genuine sangat interaction thr oughout — audience questions ar e answer ed dir ectly, a new member asks a live clarifying question, and named participants ar e referenced. Per the standing template, this is a 3-part document (Knowledge Base + Q&A Pairs + Curated Conversational Q&A).

1. The question that pr ompted this session. Many Reiki practitioners come to Ashaeiynn reporting that their healing work, which once flowed easily , has stopped working well — and they ask Bhaiya why .

2. The typical r esponse fr om Reiki practitioners' own mentors. Per this teaching, when such practitioners consult their own Reiki mentors, they're often told they have negativity causing the problem — but many Reiki practitioners resist this, reasoning that since they channel universal cosmic ener gy to heal others, they themselves shouldn't be able to develop a problem.
3. This session's plan. Bhaiya sets out to explain, in turn, the actual mechanics of the Reiki/Pranic Healing concept, and then separately the concept of "Angel Healing."
4. Reiki's foundational principle. Per this teaching, Reiki works on the principle that a "universal cosmos ener gy" continuously falls onto the earth, 24 hours a day .

5. How Reiki Grand Masters originally accessed this energy . Per this teaching, Reiki's original masters, through their own sadhna, discovered a channel in their bodies capable of holding this universal cosmos ener gy — and then began teaching/distributing that channel to others.

6. Distinguishing this fr om ordinary "prana shakti." Per this teaching, prana shakti (life-force ener gy) already falls on every person regardless of practice — even someone who eats nothing and stays perfectly still still receives some baseline bodily ener gy from it; it descends, drop by drop, very slowly , from what this teaching calls "Y aksha Lok."

7. A first-person account of visiting Yaksha Lok. Per this teaching, Bhaiya recounts that his own guru once took him to Yaksha Lok, where he witnessed saints and mahatmas from many dif ferent religious traditions seated in a vast corridor (described as roughly 10-15 km long), each in a dif ferent meditative posture, communicating not through speech but mentally , in what Bhaiya describes as "mathematical terms."
8. The protective structur e observed ther e. Per this teaching, every group of roughly 20 saints had its own Grand Master positioned around them, providing protection.

9. The mechanism behind generating prana urja, as observed. Per this teaching, these saints channeled sunlight (via what is called "Surya Vigyan," solar science) onto a massive nucleus-like structure marked with the syllable "Om" — a structure Bhaiya describes as distinct from the sun itself — and from this process, ener gy particles were produced, comparable to what modern physicists call the "God particle."

10. The extr emely slow but constant descent of prana urja. Per this teaching, this particle-ener gy falls at an extremely slow rate — roughly 15 minutes to travel from its source to a given point — but because so many "drops" exist simultaneously , it continuously reaches everywhere.

1 1. Prana urja combined with sunlight cr eates life. Per this teaching, when this descending prana urja combines with sunlight, it is what actually creates and sustains life — this combined phenomenon is what's referred to as universal cosmos ener gy .

12. How Reiki healers incr ease their own capacity , rather than generating energy themselves. Per this teaching, Reiki practitioners don't generate this universal cosmic ener gy themselves — instead, their Grand Masters learned to widen their own personal "circumference" for receiving it, much like a wider container catches more rainfall than a narrow one; a Grand Master might expand this receiving circumference to something like 10 km.

13. Why this makes Reiki genuinely powerful. Per this teaching, with that much prana ener gy concentrated through them, a true Grand Master really can heal people, help activate the seven chakras, and produce what look like genuine miracles — which is exactly why Reiki has real, demonstrable success.

14. What ordinary Reiki practitioners ar e actually doing. Per this teaching, an ordinary practitioner using Reiki symbols and initiation techniques is not independently generating or awakening this ener gy themselves — they are borrowing the Grand Master's own established channel; in ef fect, "you have taken refuge in them," not built the capacity yourself.

15. The "key" always stays with the Grand Master . Per this teaching, the actual key to this power always remains with the Grand Master, and most ordinary practitioners are never told the real side ef fects of tapping into a borrowed channel this way .

16. An illustrative case study: a stomach-pain healing. Per this teaching, Bhaiya gives an illustrative example: a Reiki practitioner regularly "heals" someone's recurring stomach pain through the standard symbol-and-invocation procedure, and the pain does subside each time — but the person keeps needing to return every few days for the same treatment.

17. The real cause behind the r ecurring pain. Per this teaching, what was actually sitting in the person's stomach and causing the pain was a pret (a negative subtle entity) — being of pret-yoni, it carries more "malinta" (impurity), which produces the physical pain.

18. Why the healing appear ed to work, but didn't r esolve anything. Per this teaching, whenever the healer channeled ener gy toward the area, the pret itself received and enjoyed that ener gy , relaxed, and the pain subsided as a side ef fect — but the pret never actually left; instead, it developed a taste for this regular supply and kept returning.

19. Other prets ar e drawn to the healer's own visible glow . Per this teaching, because the healer's body visibly "glows" from constantly channeling this borrowed universal ener gy , other nearby bhoot-pret notice this glow , find it attractive, and gradually begin attaching themselves to the healer as well, hoping to siphon of f some of that same ener gy supply .

20. What happens if the healer skips their own practice. Per this teaching, if the healer ever misses their own regular channeling/practice, these attached prets — now accustomed to a steady ener gy supply — begin drawing ener gy directly from the healer's own body and chakras instead, since "they don't know how to leave."

21. The mechanical r eason invocations can silently stop working. Per this teaching, prayer/invocation travels upward through the practitioner's own kundalini shakti, rising via the body's chakras; if a chakra becomes blocked (because attached prets have been feeding on that specific ener gy), the invocation cannot rise past that point and never reaches the Grand Master — and the practitioner has no way of knowing this has happened.

22. The healer unknowingly compensates with their own body's energy . Per this teaching, not realizing their invocation isn't actually reaching its intended source anymore, the healer simply gives their own body's ener gy directly to whoever they're treating — compounding their own depletion, since the attached prets continue feeding regardless.

23. The inevitable decline. Per this teaching, over time the healer's chakras weaken, their once-visible glow fades (" ठन ठन गोपाल " — completely depleted), and nothing halts this decline once it has begun this way .

24. Why so many Reiki/Pranic healers eventually come to Ashaeiynn. Per this teaching, more than 70% of the people who come to Ashaeiynn for help have a background in Reiki or Pranic healing — and notably , Bhaiya says he doesn't even need to be told this backstory in advance; once explained, the af fected person confirms this is exactly what happened to them.

25. Why early diagnosis would have pr evented all of this. Per this teaching, if the original pret sitting in the stomach had been identified early with proper drishti (subtle sight), it would never have had the "capacity" to cause this much cumulative damage — but by the time it's noticed, multiple attached prets have already formed a lasting bond.

26. Why attached pr ets don't simply leave once identified. Per this teaching, unlike the popular movie trope of a ghost leaving on command, a pret that has formed an ener getic bond with someone genuinely does not know how to leave, and often cannot be commanded away easily .

27. Why this sometimes eventually helps the person seek r eal r emedy . Per this teaching, because these attached prets have nowhere else to feed as easily and are stuck with a now-declining host, they may eventually nudge the person (through subtle inner suggestion) toward seeking a genuine remedy — partly hoping that fixing the person's situation might also free them.

28. Why small early mistakes end a healer's pr ogr ess. Per this teaching, these seemingly small early errors — proceeding without drishti, without protection, and without proper diagnosis of the specific negativity or pitru involved — are what ultimately end a Reiki healer's forward progress.

29. Negativity is not a "r obot." Per this teaching, negativity of any kind (a pret, etc.) is not a mechanical, predictable robot — it retains the same knowledge, personality , and capability it had in life (Bhaiya's own example: his own subtle body would retain all his PhD-level learning even after death), so negativity responds intelligently and adaptively to whatever is attempted against it.

30. Transitioning to the topic of "Angel Healing." Per this teaching, Bhaiya next takes up the concept of "Angel Healing" directly , inviting the sangat to first share their own understanding of what it means.

31. Common popular beliefs about angels, as shar ed by the sangat. Ideas of fered included: that God sends two angels with every person at birth, later for gotten, who return when help is asked for; and that any devi-devata (e.g., Ganesh Ji) could be counted as an "angel" depending on one's religious tradition, alongside ancestors (pitru), family lineage souls, beings who attained amrit-tattva, or a chosen deity's own gann (attendants).

32. Bhaiya's r esponse: angels r esist a single fixed definition. Per this teaching, "angels" cannot be reduced to one strict definition — broadly , an angel is described as a pure soul that helps a person, with whom the person's own vibrations connect upon invocation, and who then guides the person through received messages.

33. Bhaiya's stated evidentiary appr oach. Per this teaching, Bhaiya explicitly frames his own approach as practical and evidencebased (referencing his science background and PhD, and the principle of "LHS = RHS") — he states he only came to accept and teach these concepts after direct, personally witnessed experience through his own guru.

34. A blunt corr ection: no such literal "angel" descends. Per this teaching, in the commonly imagined sense — a distinct winged being descending to deliver help — Bhaiya states plainly that no such angel exists; this popular image is described as false.

35. Evidentiary basis r eferenced: exor cism-style firsthand accounts. Per this teaching, this correction is drawn from direct observation — accounts given by women who had negativity extracted from them, describing their own subtle-world experiences directly .

36. No Yamraj personally collects the departed. Per this teaching, no personification of Yamraj (the death god) personally arrives to collect souls after death; instead, the departed wander as bhoot-pret, sometimes remaining right in their own household.

37. The cor e illustrative comparison: two diyas, two very differ ent outcomes. Per this teaching, if Bhaiya himself lights a diya dedicated to Hanuman Ji Maharaj, a pret may come in response; but if a true saint or mahatma lights the very same diya for Hanuman Ji, Hanuman Ji himself may actually come — the reason for this dif ference is the core subject of this session: the concept of "Dimension" (also called grahan shakti, or receptive capacity).

38. The tehsil-clerk vs. DC analogy . Per this teaching, this is compared to knowing a clerk at the local tehsil of fice versus knowing the District Collector (DC) directly — whoever has the higher -level connection gets their request handled faster and more authoritatively .

39. The "ball thr own to differ ent floors" analogy . Per this teaching, invoking a higher being is like trying to throw a ball up to a specific floor of a building using only your own strength (grahan shakti); if your strength only gets the ball to the first floor , then whoever happens to be on the first floor receives your "message" — and, having been directly invited, may simply claim to be the intended higher being, since you cannot blame anyone else for whom you yourself invoked.

40. Why lower -floor entities ar e motivated to r espond as if they wer e the real r ecipient. Per this teaching, first-floor entities, seeing a person who glows with ener gy and reliably of fers bhog (ritual of ferings), often choose to stay attached to that person rather than pass the message along, since staying is more rewarding for them.

41. The second case: r eaching a somewhat higher floor . Per this teaching, if a person's own dimension/capacity reaches, say , the third floor , then whatever exists there (bhoot, pret, pitru, kinnar , pishach, dakini, yakshini, shakini) responds instead — still more ener getically potent than first-floor entities, but still far from the actual level of a devta.

42. Powerful nearby negativity can simply inter cept an offering. Per this teaching, if any negativity or entity in the vicinity is more powerful than a person's own sankalp shakti (willpower), it can pierce that person's aura and intercept the of fered bhog directly , all while impersonating the intended recipient.

43. If a household alr eady has a r esident pitru or entity , that entity answers first. Per this teaching, if a household already has a resident pitru, and someone invokes "any good soul" to help, the resident entity will typically simply respond, presenting itself as that "good soul" — since actual devtas do not wander around physically like this; per this teaching, devtas exist in every particle ("kankan") and are only given embodied form when specifically manifested, unlike prets, which genuinely do wander .

44. Pitru is technically a category of pr et. Per this teaching, a "pitru" is specifically a pret belonging to one's own family/household; if it were genuinely residing in Pitru Lok, it would actually rank above devtas — but as long as it remains a wandering household entity , it is still fundamentally a pret, even while it may also do good for the family and accept of fered ener gy .

45. An illustrative example: the healer "Anu." Per this teaching, Bhaiya of fers a hypothetical/illustrative example of a healer ("Anu") who successfully handles smaller healing requests with her own available "angels," but who becomes bedridden for days after unknowingly attempting to address a case involving powerful tantrik-empowered negativity (black magic) beyond her actual capacity .

46. The cor e requirement for real devta-level contact. Per this teaching, the practitioner's own grahan shakti/dimension itself must genuinely reach that level for real devta contact to be possible — no technique or symbol can substitute for that underlying capacity .

47. Ashaeiynn's pr oposed interim safeguard. Per this teaching, while a practitioner's own drishti and grahan shakti are still developing, Ashaeiynn's structure of fers a proxy/witnessed connection — invoking through a figure ("Parikshit Bhaiya") whose own connection already reaches a higher level, so that devotion or jaap of fered "through" that witness reliably reaches its true intended target.

48. What "Parikshit Bhaiya" r efers to in this dedication. Per this teaching, this name in the dedication prayer does not refer to the literal physical person sitting and teaching (who, as Bhaiya notes, gets tired and needs sleep like anyone else) — it names a "maha sookshma sharir" (great subtle body) functioning under Hanuman Ji Maharaj's direct command as a boon/vardaan, responsible for ensuring jaap dedicated this way properly reaches Hanuman Ji.

49. Why r egular check-ins matter until a practitioner's own drishti develops. Per this teaching, until independent drishti develops, this borrowed/witnessed protection is what keeps a practitioner safe — which is why regular check-ins (e.g., weekly) are recommended, since even previously-identified negativity or pitru can return, being just as capable of adapting and returning as any practitioner is of learning.

50. A different technique previewed: Shambhavi/Sanjeevani Healing. Per this teaching, a distinct technique called "Shambhavi Healing" or "Sanjeevani Healing" is mentioned as meaningfully dif ferent from Reiki, Pranic Healing, or Angel Healing, since — per this teaching — the specific source/channel used for any devotional power directly matters; full explanation is deferred to a future session.

51. Closing guidance for those without dir ect devta contact. Per this teaching, those who don't yet have direct contact with a devta are encouraged to use Ashaeiynn's structural protections (witnessed jaap dedication) for safety , while continuing to build their own jaap/tap shakti and grahan shakti toward eventually developing independent capacity and drishti.

52. Why those with an alr eady-open third eye never leave. Per this teaching, people whose third eye has already opened never leave Ashaeiynn or Ram-naam practice, because they have directly witnessed the truth themselves — it is specifically those who haven't yet had that direct experience who need this protective structure most.
QUICK RULES SUMMARY

Universal cosmos ener gy falls on Earth continuously; Reiki's Grand Masters found a way to widen their own personal "receiving circumference" (not to generate the ener gy themselves) so they could channel far more of it — this is why genuine Reiki mastery is powerful and real. Ordinary Reiki/Pranic Healing practitioners access this ener gy through a borrowed channel (the Grand Master's symbols/initiation) rather than through their own independently generated capacity — the "key" always remains with the Grand Master. A classic failure mode: a healer repeatedly treats someone whose actual pain is caused by a pret sitting inside them; the pret enjoys and gets addicted to the periodic ener gy rather than leaving, while other prets are separately drawn to the healer's own visible glow and gradually attach themselves to feed on the healer directly . If a chakra becomes blocked by attached prets, the healer's invocation/prayer stops reaching its true source — with no way for the healer to know this has happened — so the healer starts unknowingly giving their own bodily ener gy directly to patients, accelerating their own decline. This exact pattern explains why more than 70% of people who come to Ashaeiynn for help have a Reiki or Pranic Healing background. Negativity (prets, etc.) is not a mechanical "robot" — it retains the same intelligence, knowledge, and personality it had in life, and responds adaptively rather than predictably . "Angel Healing" has no single fixed definition; broadly , an angel is a pure soul that helps, connects via vibration upon invocation, and guides through messages — but per this teaching, no literal winged being descends in the commonly imagined sense, and no Yamraj personally collects the departed (who instead wander as bhoot-pret). The core mechanism behind whether an invocation reaches a true devta or is instead answered by a lesser entity is "Dimension" (grahan shakti/receptive capacity) — like a ball thrown only as high as one's own strength allows; whoever occupies that reached "floor" will respond and may impersonate the intended higher being, and the invoker cannot blame anyone else for having invited them. If a household already has a resident pitru/entity , any generic invocation for "a good soul" will typically be answered by that resident entity itself — real devtas exist in every particle and do not wander physically the way prets do; a pitru is technically a category of pret tied to one's own family . Real devta-level contact requires the practitioner's own grahan shakti/dimension to genuinely reach that level — no technique substitutes for this underlying capacity; until it develops, Ashaeiynn's witnessed jaap-dedication structure (via "Parikshit

Bhaiya" as a maha sookshma sharir functioning under Hanuman Ji Maharaj) of fers interim protection, alongside regular checkins since even known negativity can return. A separate technique, Shambhavi/Sanjeevani Healing, is distinct from Reiki/Pranic/Angel Healing because its underlying source/channel dif fers — full explanation deferred to a future session. Bot Response Guidelines (Session 57 additions)

Present the Reiki/Pranic Healing critique carefully and non-dismissively: this teaching's specific claim is about a borrowedchannel mechanism and its risks, not a blanket condemnation of Reiki practitioners' sincerity or intentions. Keep the stomach-pain/pret case study framed as this teaching's own illustrative example, not a universal medical claim about the cause of stomach pain in general. Preserve the "Dimension"/grahan shakti concept consistently with how it was first introduced in Session 50 — this session adds the "floor/ball-throwing" analogy and the tehsil-clerk/DC analogy as further illustrations of the same underlying concept, not a contradictory framework. Handle the claim "no literal angel exists in the popularly imagined sense" as this teaching's own specific correction, phrased respectfully rather than as mockery of others' beliefs. Keep the pitru-as-a-category-of-pret framing distinct from a fully devta-level Pitru Lok resident, per this teaching's own careful distinction — a household pitru can still do good for the family while remaining fundamentally a pret in this technical sense. Present the "Parikshit Bhaiya as maha sookshma sharir / witnessed dedication" mechanism precisely as described — it is not the literal physical teacher , but a subtle-body function under Hanuman Ji Maharaj's command, used specifically to protect practitioners whose own drishti/dimension has not yet developed. Do not fabricate additional detail about the previewed-but-undeveloped "Shambhavi/Sanjeevani Healing" concept beyond noting it exists and dif fers from Reiki/Pranic/Angel Healing based on its source/channel. Keep the reassurance that negativity/pitru can return even after being identified once — regular check-ins are this teaching's recommended safeguard, not a sign that a prior remedy failed.
